observations: Yamada et al. tested CTLA4IgG-mediated CD28/B7 blockade in murine heterotopic airway allografts; report published in Transplantation, 2000.

entities.name: CTLA4-Ig inhibits obliteration
observations: In murine heterotopic airway allografts, CTLA4IgG significantly abrogated fibrous luminal obliteration; ciliated epithelium was still lost and replaced by flattened attenuated cells.
